hero.title: Lathe machine and milling machine center
hero.lead: Looking for a trusted machine shop in Houston? Liberty Precision offers ISO9001:2015 - AS9100D certified by PRI Registrar machining, delivering quality machined parts.

summary: Liberty Precision Company offers lathe machine center, milling machine center and electrical discharge machine across Houston and Liberty.

groups.title: Lathe Machine Center
groups.summary: Our CNC Precision Turning involves advanced 2- and 3-axis lathe machine centers capable of handling parts from 1” to 78” OD and up to 240” in length. This allows for precise, efficient turning operations for a broad range of part sizes and specifications.

groups.title: Precision Surface Finishing Center
groups.summary: Our deburring and grinding services enhance the quality and performance of your metalworking projects.
groups.intro: Our deburring and grinding services enhance the quality and performance of your metalworking projects. Utilizing advanced grinding machines and deburring machines, we achieve superior surface finishes and remove unwanted burrs and sharp edges. This process is vital for achieving precision and safety in the final product.

about.title: About Liberty Precision Company
text: Our success at Liberty Precision is driven by the expertise and dedication of our exceptional team. With over 450 years of combined machining experience, we produce an average of 12,000 parts per year and maintain an industry-leading low scrap rate.
Meet our dedicated team of machining experts who deliver precision and quality in every project.
Liberty Precision is an ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D, PRI Registrar certified machine shop. We are experts in the quick delivery of complicated and prototype jobs.
